index_character: Formal sections and tag IDs in a strongly structured multichapter mathematics reference
source_observation: Directly accessible 2026-10-19 home page includes an explicit browse/table-of-contents link and section-tag navigation. Existing independently screened source records already use stable tag permalinks.
new_research_route: Use topical Stacks browse sections and direct stable tags for individually read, originally paraphrased definitions; do not bulk copy source chapters and do not mistake mathematical propositions for definition entries.

index_character: Dedicated searchable mathematics definitions category distinct from proof index
source_observation: The ProofWiki main page links its definitions index to Category:Definitions, which is directly reachable. Definition pages have individually versioned context labels; wiki text should be independently mathematically cross-checked before acceptance.
new_research_route: Use definition-category index to discover targeted missing foundations; independently paraphrase, cite exact article URLs and explicitly compare multiple textbook conventions before screening.

index_character: Alphabetical list of separately linked mathematical articles including category theory and topology topics
source_observation: The PlanetMath alphabetical HTML index resolves and shows linked mathematical topic articles, including category theory materials. The index listing alone cannot establish that an exact topic has an independently verified rigorous definition.
new_research_route: Select specific independently indexed topical pages for individual mathematical source verification and retain attribution/provenance; assess local definition hypotheses and concept variant contexts.
